subject: How many tasks should I specify with mapred.reduce.tasks?

messages.author: 6d270f045553771e
messages.subject: How many tasks should I specify with mapred.reduce.tasks?
parts:
I'm just wondering if there's a good rule for determining what to set the mapred.reduce.tasks option to when executing with rhwatch?

I'm pretty new to Rhipe and this sort of software in general, so I've been following along with this tutorial: http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhafen/rhipe/
The tutorial is pretty vague about when to set mapred = 0 tasks, 1 task, or 4 tasks. All I've got is that mapred.reduce.tasks = 0 sends output directly to HDFS


Thanks!

Frank
